content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Prod API Gateway (api-gw-prod, us-east-1) elevated 502/504 rate. window=15m, 5xx_rate=11.9% (alert threshold=1%). Top client routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pager: @mae (oncall)

mae (oncall): oncall here. seeing the alert. pulling up Grafana and gateway logs now.

elena (deploy): fyi I pushed a config bump to api-gw today ~15:12 UTC (edge-route pruning + new timeout defaults). Not sure if related.

mae (oncall): good to know, @elena. raj, can you join? likely routing/timeouts at edge.

raj (platform): joining. I can access the edge pods. starting with `kubectl get pods -n infra api-gw-prod -o wide` and checking replicas.

ops-runner-bot: recent deploys: deploy/batch/edge-config v2026-03-14-1512 by elena, rollout=100%.

sam (sre): quick check: curl against gateway shows intermittent 502. `curl -sv https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/health` -> some responses 200, some 502.

mae (oncall): paste logs?

raj (platform): tailing logs: `kubectl logs -n infra api-gw-prod-6f7b -c envoy --since=10m` shows repeated upstream connect errors and 504 from upstream: "upstream connect timeout or reset by peer". also seeing TLS handshake errors to internal-model-proxy on some pods.

elena (deploy): I changed timeout from 2s -> 1s for internal proxy on the config; maybe too aggressive for some backends under load.

mae (oncall): hypothesis: new edge timeout + spike in backend latency -> gateway returns 502/504. mitigation idea: rollback timeout or increase to 3s; temporarily scale model-proxy or disable the prune change.

raj (platform): I can patch the gateway config live to restore previous timeout. prepping a kube patch now.

sam (sre): customers impacted: about 7% of requests to hosted API hitting errors (per traffic slice), error spike started at 15:08 UTC and peaked ~15:20. No major customer reported yet but telemetry shows failed requests to 12 paying customers (request correlation ids attached).

mae (oncall): priority: reduce customer-visible errors immediately. Raj, do a quick config change and increase timeout back to 2.5s. If rollback not safe, scale model-proxy deployment by +50% as fallback.

raj (platform): applying patch: `kubectl -n infra patch cm api-gw-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"upstream_timeout":"2.5s"}}'` and sending SIGHUP to gateways. executing now.

ops-runner-bot: deploy patch job queued -> patch applied to configmap api-gw-config. restarting api-gw pods with rolling restart.

elena (deploy): creating a fast rollback if needed: I have the previous config saved as v2026-03-14-1505.

mae (oncall): monitoring metrics. Sam, can you watch the 5xx graph and SLO dashboard?

sam (sre): watching. within 90s we're seeing a drop from 11.9% -> 6.2%. still tailing errors but trending down.

raj (platform): also scaled model-proxy deployment from 20 -> 30 replicas as a precaution: `kubectl scale deploy model-proxy -n infra --replicas=30`. pods coming up.

mae (oncall): nice. any signs of degraded downstream (model infra) queues or CPU spikes?

sam (sre): model infra latency improved a bit after scale. CPU on some nodes is higher but within limits. no obvious memory pressure.

ops-runner-bot: incident annotation: mitigation step 1 applied - gateway timeout increased, model-proxy scaled.

mae (oncall): error rate now 0.9% over the last 2m. rolling restart finished. I'll keep this thread open for a final confirmation period (30m).

elena (deploy): will open a PR to revert the aggressive timeout change and add canary gating + perf tests for internal-proxy calls.

raj (platform): creating a short-lived traffic-sink test to validate timeouts; also adding a backup routing policy to avoid pods that return TLS errors.

sam (sre): customer impact summary for postmortem: ~12 paying customers experienced transient 502/504s, peak error rate 11.9% for ~12 minutes, total failed requests ~18k. No data loss, retries succeeded for most.

mae (oncall): good. next actions: 1) elena to revert/soften timeout change + add automated canary checks (owner: elena). 2) raj to add a guard in the gateway to avoid aggressive timeouts during backend latency spikes (owner: raj). 3) sam to draft incident timeline and customer-impact notes (owner: sam). I'll put together a postmortem after 24h.

elena (deploy): ack. I'll start PR and include perf numbers.

raj (platform): ack. I'll also add a monitoring alert for sudden timeout config changes in prod.

mae (oncall): final check: error rate holding <1% for 10m. closing on-call handoff in 20m. If anything regresses ping this thread or page again.

ops-runner-bot: incident resolved (mitigated) in 16m. tagging for postmortem.

mae (oncall): closing incident thread now; filing incident ticket INC-2026-0314-01 and linking this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
